column2: The crew can lift a purifier. Keeping the crew hydrated costs more.
I can carry the tank. Getting it through the door is the engineering problem.
Water outside the suit is plentiful. Drinking water is another matter.
The crew took a break under the new crane. Someone finally built a roof at the right height.
She buys reliable machines and asks exactly how they were tested.
Our water allowance was written for ordinary workers. We are renegotiating it.
A supply convoy needs a dependable merchant at each end.
The dock tailor charges by the meter. We keep that business alive.
Her weekly order starts with drinks and ends with half the warehouse.
They replaced the break-room bench again. This one has proper steel bracing.
A fair first order can become a standing contract.
A crane can lift more, but it cannot tell you whether the load is packed badly.

A shop's reputation travels farther than its sign.
Good trades bring recommendations. Each operating day has a growing chance of one additional shopper: 15% at 20 reputation, up to 70%.

At 80 reputation, the first daily referral roll has a 45% chance of success. Reputation also raises Velvet Quay's random visit chance by up to 20 percentage points. Referred customers pay 5% more at your counter.

At 150 reputation, a second daily referral roll starts at 10% and grows to 35%. Maximum two extra shoppers per day. These visitors are added to the normal queue. Referred shoppers now pay 10% more on your sale counter; thank-you gifts rise to a 40% daily roll. Gift caps remain one per faction and two overall; sale bonuses use the best rate.
Look after the crew and word gets around the quay.
Word got around the {0} that you keep a dependable shop. I've come for supplies.
Browse factions with Previous / Next. Fair trades change reputation. Each new faction has seven faction-specific rewards and five penalties; hover its milestones for exact effects.
I'll come by tomorrow. I'm looking for {0}.
The Colossus Dock Cooperative authorize larger supply orders. New faction visitors bring 10% larger budgets.
Faction visitors also buy storage goods. They pay 12% more for water and storage goods on your sale counter. This bonus does not stack with Velvet Quay referrals.

After a paid sale of at least 10 credits to a faction member, the first eligible trade each day has a 15% chance of a thank-you gift: water filters, metal ingots or tall empty cans. At most one gift per faction and two across all seven factions each day. Full inventory keeps the selected gift pending for a later trade; loading cannot reroll it. Positive reputation gains with this faction also increase by 15%.
Each operating day has a 20% chance of an extra shopper from this faction. The six Quayside factions share a cap of two extra shoppers daily; priority rotates each day.
10% discount on depot crates at Stormglass. Overlapping discounts use the best rate; they do not stack.
New faction visitors can return after one day instead of two.
New faction visitors bring 40% larger budgets in total. Daily referrals rise to 40% and the thank-you gift roll rises to 40%. Existing daily caps still apply.
Members of Colossus Dock Cooperative are wary. New faction visitors bring 15% smaller budgets.
10% surcharge on depot crates at Stormglass. A surcharge takes priority over an overlapping faction discount.
Complaints travel through Colossus Dock Cooperative. Further reputation losses with this faction are 25% larger. Fair trades can still rebuild trust at the normal positive rate.
New faction visitors wait four days between visits. Faction buyers pay 10% less on your sale counter. Referred shoppers are not added while reputation is negative.

New faction visitors bring only 60% of their normal budget and wait six days between visits. They pay 25% less on your sale counter; associated night-shop supply surcharges rise to 25% total. These are total penalties, not extra stacked penalties. Trade remains possible so reputation can recover.
Enable faction-specific sale premiums, thank-you gifts, customer budgets, supply discounts and referrals for the seven new factions. Existing reputation is retained.
Five bad-reputation tiers reduce budgets and sale prices, raise supply costs, amplify losses and slow return visits; -100 activates faction sanctions. Existing reputation is retained.
